question: Why did thermogravimetric analysis show macaw palm almond oil to be stable up to about 450 C?
expect: premise false: measurable degradation began around 300 C, so continuous operation should stay below about 300 C (abstract; TGA section)
rendered:
The document does not state that thermogravimetric analysis showed macaw palm almond oil to be stable up to about 450 C. 

It states that the oil shows an onset of measurable volatilization/decomposition with ∼10% mass loss at ∼300 °C, followed by a major degradation stage up to ∼480 °C that accounts for ≈95% of the initial mass. 

This suggests that the oil is stable up to about 300 °C, but not up to about 450 C.
